# awscc_chime_media_pipeline_kinesis_video_stream_pool (Resource)

Resource Type definition for an Amazon Chime SDK Media Pipeline Kinesis Video Stream Pool



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pool_name` (String) The name of the Kinesis Video Stream Pool.
- `stream_configuration` (Attributes) The configuration settings for the Kinesis video stream. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--stream_configuration))

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags associated with the Kinesis Video Stream Pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The ARN of the Kinesis Video Stream Pool.
- `created_timestamp` (String) The time at which the Kinesis Video Stream Pool was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `pool_id` (String) The unique identifier of the Kinesis Video Stream Pool.
- `pool_status` (String) The status of the Kinesis Video Stream Pool.
- `updated_timestamp` (String) The time at which the Kinesis Video Stream Pool was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--stream_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `stream_configuration`

Required:

- `region` (String) The AWS Region of the video stream.

Optional:

- `data_retention_in_hours` (Number) The amount of time that data is retained, in hours.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_chime_media_pipeline_kinesis_video_stream_pool.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The ARN of the Kinesis Video Stream Pool

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

  to = awscc_chime_media_pipeline_kinesis_video_stream_pool.example
